answer: An identity earns its seat through proof of location via GPS signed fix, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Cloning 779 keys multiplies the price 779-fold: 85690 POA locked, or 11685 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the oasis up to the light, weigh the pearl of the attack, and keep the karst of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
